notes: Legacy P2PKH Bitcoin Signed Message vectors independently published by bitcoinj. The license text is the revision's root COPYING file with one terminal LF added; no Open BSV Go SDK source, fixture, or oracle output is included.

files.transformation: Selected the compressed and uncompressed legacy P2PKH verification cases; preserved each UTF-8 message, Base64 signature, and mainnet address exactly; represented the Java declarations as strict JSON and added the compression expectation stated by each upstream test name.
files.notes: The compressed case is identified upstream as generated by Bitcoin-Qt. SegWit/BIP-137 vectors were intentionally excluded because this packet accepts only legacy headers 27...34.
